prompt: RFC 7230 quoted-pair backslash escape allowed control characters
answer:
RFC 7230 allows a quoted-pair to escape:

- HTAB (horizontal tab)
- SP (space)
- VCHAR (visible US-ASCII characters)
- obs-text (`%x80–FF`)

Its grammar is:

```abnf
quoted-pair = "\" ( HTAB / SP / VCHAR / obs-text )
```

Thus, among control characters, only HTAB is allowed; other control characters, including NUL, are not.
